// BrakeData: CAN ID 0x300 (standard), 6 bytes, sender ABS, cycle time 20 ms
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from demo.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[5] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// WheelSpeedFL: start bit 7, 16 bits, Motorola, unsigned, factor 0.01, offset 0, range 0 .. 655.35 km/h
WheelSpeedFL_raw = (data[0] << 8) | data[1]
WheelSpeedFL = WheelSpeedFL_raw * 0.01

// WheelSpeedFR: start bit 23, 16 bits, Motorola, unsigned, factor 0.01, offset 0, range 0 .. 655.35 km/h
WheelSpeedFR_raw = (data[2] << 8) | data[3]
WheelSpeedFR = WheelSpeedFR_raw * 0.01

// BrakePressure: start bit 39, 10 bits, Motorola, unsigned, factor 0.5, offset 0, range 0 .. 511.5 bar
BrakePressure_raw = (data[4] << 2) | (data[5] >> 6)
BrakePressure = BrakePressure_raw * 0.5

// AbsActive: start bit 45, 1 bit, Motorola, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 1
// values: 0 = "Inactive", 1 = "Active"
AbsActive_raw = (data[5] >> 5) & 0x01
AbsActive = AbsActive_raw
